purpose: Select one semantically identifiable signal family per frozen assay channel for healthy-pancreas pretraining; retain biological and technical replicates but never alias incompatible transforms into the same condition vector.

polyA plus RNA-seq: minus strand signal of unique reads
plus strand signal of unique reads
total RNA-seq: minus strand signal of unique reads
plus strand signal of unique reads
RAMPAGE: minus strand signal of unique reads
plus strand signal of unique reads

excluded_signal_families.fold change over control: incompatible scale with signal p-value under the frozen assay vector
excluded_signal_families.signal of all reads: redundant with and less specific than unique-read strand signal
excluded_signal_families.CpG sites coverage: coverage is not a methylation-state target

audit_policy: Retain released canonical tracks with ENCODE audit errors only when their replicate-quality condition is 0.5; primary sensitivity analysis must also report the audit-error-free subset.
replicate_policy: Retain biological and technical replicates after semantic selection; sample_group remains the ENCODE experiment so splitting and validation keep an experiment intact.
